incident_commander_privacy_owner_technic.rule: Operational ownership for incident commander, privacy owner and technical owner must be explicitly assigned and independently reviewable.

risk_classification_matrix_artifact.rule: A reviewed incident risk classification matrix must exist; the collector cannot infer severity or notification obligations.

operator_to_controller_handoff_procedure.rule: A reviewed operator-to-controller handoff procedure must define ownership, timing, evidence transfer and escalation.

anpd_data_subject_communication_decision.rule: A reviewed procedure must govern ANPD/data-subject communication decisions. Scripts cannot make or attest legal notification conclusions.

incident_registry_retention_control_arti.rule: A reviewed incident-registry retention control must define evidence preservation and access governance.

cross_tenant_exposure_tabletop_receipt.rule: A controlled tabletop using synthetic/non-customer fixtures must exercise suspected cross-tenant exposure response.

credential_compromise_tabletop_receipt.rule: A controlled tabletop using synthetic/non-customer fixtures must exercise credential compromise response, containment and evidence handling.

potentially_sensitive_student_data_table.rule: A controlled tabletop using synthetic/non-customer fixtures must exercise potentially sensitive student-data incident handling.

final_drill_postmortem_artifact.rule: A final drill/postmortem artifact must bind findings, remediation owners and follow-up evidence.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: COLLECT_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Hash real reviewed governance artifacts and controlled tabletop receipts; record only non-sensitive metadata.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEW_RECEIPT_AND_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Confirm ownership, risk classification, handoff, notification decision procedure, retention, three tabletop scenarios and final drill/postmortem.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Only after real review, create a separate versioned migration updating exactly incident_response with evidence_ref and evidence_digest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_APPLY_ONCE
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Apply the exact merged evidence migration through Supabase.apply_migration only; execute_sql remains SELECT-only.
